description: Call before crawling, quoting or training on content from a website. Reads the domain's robots.txt for 14 AI crawlers and user-fetch agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, CCBot...), ai.txt and W3C TDMRep, and summarizes whether AI training is opted out. Free, no key, cached 6 hours. Signals, not a license. Call with {"domain": "example.com"}.

domain.description: Host name such as example.com (a URL is accepted)
